key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns Policy Mirror Descent into a trajectory-level objective for terminal-reward autoregressive generation, removing the need to estimate intermediate state values.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a practical critic-free training recipe for reasoning LLMs, which can simplify RLVR pipelines and reduce instability from value-function approximation.
method: Uses Bellman equations to reformulate PMD over full trajectories instead of intermediate states.
Derives a practical loss from the reformulated objective for autoregressive token generation.
Applies a smoothed complementary-probability ratio as a mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing BPO is effective.
watch_item: The practical loss relies on an approximation of the exact trajectory objective, so performance may depend on how well the mismatch-correction term is implemented and tuned.
